chunks: Hammād ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Rubayʿ, from al-Faḍl, from Abū  ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
A man came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, who among the people has the most perfect faith?' He said, 'Those who have the best character.'
ai.seo_question: What is the sign of perfect faith according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through the chain of Hammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq), underscores the Shia emphasis on *husn al-khuluq* as the tangible manifestation of *iman*. It aligns with the Prophetic tradition that faith is not merely doctrinal but ethically operational, a concept deeply rooted in the Quranic description of the Prophet as possessing 'enormous character' (68:4). In Shia scholarship, this link serves as a criterion for evaluating the authenticity of one's religious practice, where moral excellence is seen as the fruit of true belief.
